title: 结点电压法的交流版：两个结点
statement: 和 World 2 的 `methods-03-nodal-two-nodes` 同一个结构，只是中间的 R_2 换成了电感 L，两个电流源换成了同频率的正弦源。
ω = 1000 rad/s，İ_s1 = 5∠0° A（向上，注入结点 a），İ_s2 = 3∠0° A（向下，从结点 b 流出），均为有效值相量；R_1 = 6 Ω，L = 8 mH，R_3 = 10 Ω。以底部为参考结点。
用**结点电压法**求结点电压相量 U̇_a、U̇_b。

questions.ask: 按标准形式 Y_aa·U̇_a + Y_ab·U̇_b = İ_sa 列结点 a 的方程，互导纳 Y_ab = ?
choiceExplain: −j0.125 S 是 L 自己的导纳 Y_L = 1/(j8)。互导纳还要再取一次负号：Y_ab = −Y_L。
这是 a 的自导纳 Y_aa = 1/R_1 + Y_L，不是互导纳。
a、b 之间连着 L，互导纳不为零。
questions.explain: 互导纳 = −（连接 a、b 的导纳）。Y_L = 1/(j8) = −j0.125 S，所以 Y_ab = −Y_L = +j0.125 S。两个负号叠在一起，最容易出错。
解出 U̇_b = −j15 V，模 15 V。两个结点电压一样大，相位却差了 126.87°。

hints: 和直流一样，每个独立结点列一个 KCL；只是电导换成导纳：G = 1/R，Y_L = 1/(jωL)。
注意 1/(j8) = −j/8：除以 j 等于乘以 −j。注入 b 的电源电流是 −İ_s2。
结点 a 的方程乘 24、结点 b 的方程乘 40，可以去掉分数；再把两式相加，右边正好抵消。

en.title: Nodal analysis, AC edition: two nodes
statement: Same structure as World 2's `methods-03-nodal-two-nodes`; only the middle R_2 has become an inductor L and the two current sources are sinusoids of the same frequency.
ω = 1000 rad/s, İ_s1 = 5∠0° A (upward, into node a), İ_s2 = 3∠0° A (downward, out of node b), both rms phasors; R_1 = 6 Ω, L = 8 mH, R_3 = 10 Ω. The bottom node is the reference.
Use **nodal analysis** to find the node-voltage phasors U̇_a and U̇_b.

questions.ask: Writing the node-a equation in the standard form Y_aa·U̇_a + Y_ab·U̇_b = İ_sa, what is the mutual admittance Y_ab?
choiceExplain: −j0.125 S is the admittance of L itself, Y_L = 1/(j8). The mutual admittance takes one more minus sign: Y_ab = −Y_L.
That is the self-admittance of a, Y_aa = 1/R_1 + Y_L, not the mutual one.
L connects a and b, so the mutual admittance is not zero.
questions.explain: Mutual admittance = −(admittance between a and b). Y_L = 1/(j8) = −j0.125 S, so Y_ab = −Y_L = +j0.125 S. Two minus signs on top of each other: the easiest place to slip.
The solution is U̇_a = 12 + j9 V, magnitude √(144 + 81) = 15 V.
The solution is U̇_b = −j15 V, magnitude 15 V. The two node voltages are the same size but 126.87° apart.

hints: As in DC, write one KCL per independent node; only the conductances become admittances: G = 1/R, Y_L = 1/(jωL).
Careful: 1/(j8) = −j/8, since dividing by j is multiplying by −j. The source current into b is −İ_s2.
Multiply the node-a equation by 24 and the node-b equation by 40 to clear the fractions; adding the two then cancels the right-hand sides.
solution: **5. Check (KCL at a).** İ_L = (U̇_a − U̇_b)/(j8) = (12 + j24)/(j8) = 3 − j1.5 A and U̇_a/R_1 = 2 + j1.5 A; together 5 A = İ_s1 ✓.
